decision: Retain frozen1800train tasks and4samples/task for this experiment; record sparse-cell exceptions before SFT. No duplication, answer replacement or acceptance of incorrect intermediate operations.
scope: Production expands pilot2tasks/cell to100tasks/cell. All1800tasks sampled, including low-yield cells; no selective omission.
target_note: 222traces/cell is a diagnostic equal allocation of4000/18, not a formal minimum. Internal coverage goals remain20SFTtasks and10DPOtasks/cell.
projection_limit: Linear extrapolation of observed retention only; task coverage does not scale linearly and responses within task are dependent. These projections are not generated results or guarantees.
rationale: Observed low retention persists after expanding to100tasks/cell and complete agent inspection of positive traces. Extra samples on the same tasks cannot guarantee the missing unique-task coverage. Expanding physical train problems would change the frozen training distribution after the reportable GRPO run and require repeating comparable routes. Preserve this experimental cut and expose imbalance as a limitation.
impact: SFT may learn mainly higher-retention families; compare family/level validation separately and do not generalize aggregate improvements to scarce cells. Luminosity/hard DPO cannot cover10tasks with only2eligible preferred tasks.
remaining: Finish remaining6cells; construct full corpus, generate actual small-model negatives, publish final counts/exceptions before SFT. I5 not complete.
human_review: All described quality reviews are by agent; human audit remains pending.
